name: TOTP Authentication System
summary: A secure two-factor authentication system with a Flutter mobile client and Java 21 Spring Boot backend.
details: The project implements TOTP-based authentication.
TOTP uses a 20-byte secret, Base32 encoding, HmacSHA1, 6-digit codes and a 30-second period.
The system supports TOTP enrollment and confirmation.
The system includes login, registration and OTP verification.
The system includes password recovery.
TOTP secrets are encrypted before storage.
The system includes replay protection for TOTP time steps.
The Flutter application includes login, registration, TOTP enrollment, OTP verification and password recovery screens.

name: Iris Recognition Attendance System
summary: A Spring Boot application that automates student attendance using iris recognition.
details: The system processes captured images using OpenCV.
A Haar cascade is used for eye detection.
The largest detected eye is selected.
A central iris-like region is extracted.
The processed region is resized to 100 by 100.
Images are compared using an L2 norm.
The best matching dataset image is used to identify the student.
Attendance marking prevents duplicate attendance for the same student on the same date.
The system includes teacher authentication and attendance dashboard endpoints.
